title: scTREAT: Latent Diffusion for Single-Cell Drug-Response Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2510.11726v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generating drug-induced transcriptional responses requires a model to account for cellular background together with molecular identity and dose. We present scTREAT, the first diffusion framework to factorize state and drug guidance for single-cell drug-response prediction. A shared latent expression space connects baseline and response, while Guided Decomposable Attention (GD-Attn) injects a baseline representation and a dose-conditioned molecular embedding. Independent channel dropout exposes four conditioning states during training; inference combines three conditional predictions with separately specified state and drug coefficients, and dose modulates drug-guidance strength. On condition-level pseudobulk profiles derived from the Tahoe-100M single-cell atlas, scTREAT achieves the best value on 10 of 12 metrics for unseen cell line-drug combinations (UC) and 11 of 12 for unseen drugs (UD). translated_abstract: 生成药物诱导的转录响应需要一个模型能够同时考虑细胞背景、分子身份和剂量。我们提出scTREAT，这是首个将细胞状态与药物引导进行因式分解的扩散框架，用于单细胞药物响应预测。一个共享的潜在表达空间连接基线与响应，同时引导可分解注意力机制（GD-Attn）注入基线表示和剂量条件化的分子嵌入。训练期间通过独立的通道丢弃机制暴露四种条件状态；推理时结合三个条件预测，分别指定状态和药物系数，且剂量可调节药物引导的强度。在源自Tahoe-100M单细胞图谱的条件级伪批量数据上，scTREAT在未见细胞系-药物组合（UC）的12项指标中有10项取得最佳值，在未见药物（UD）的12项指标中有11项取得最佳值。消融实验考察了条件注入方
tldr: scTREAT是首个将细胞状态与药物引导进行因式分解的潜在扩散框架，通过引导可分解注意力机制注入基线表示与剂量条件化的分子嵌入，在单细胞药物响应预测任务上取得了最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: scTREAT is the first latent diffusion framework that factorizes state and drug guidance for single-cell drug-response prediction, injecting baseline representations and dose-conditioned molecular embeddings via Guided Decomposable Attention to achieve state-of-the-art performance.
